This page lists the Stata DO and ADO files currently retained in `scripts/stata/` as at 17 July 2026. It describes each active or transitional file's present responsibility; detailed run instructions belong in `site/operations/` and `site/technical/`.

| Area | Relative path | Filename | Responsibility |
|:-----|:------------------------|:--------------------------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| ADO utility | `ado/` | [`bnr_workbook.ado`](ado/bnr_workbook.ado) | Creates an Excel workbook from a Stata dataset. It writes the data, dataset metadata derived from structured Stata notes, and variable metadata derived from formats, labels, value labels, and observed labelled categories to separate worksheets. |
| ADO utility | `ado/` | [`bnr_yml.ado`](ado/bnr_yml.ado) | Creates a standard BNR dataset-metadata YAML file from a Stata dataset, including file references, structured dataset notes, and variable-level types, formats, labels, and observed labelled categories. |
| Deprecated ADO | `ado/` | [`bnryaml.ado`](ado/bnryaml.ado) | **Deprecated; awaiting relocation from this folder.** |
| Annual | `annual/` | [`build_cvd_annual_tabulations.do`](annual/build_cvd_annual_tabulations.do) | Builds 2023 annual CVD tabulations, including comparisons by event type, year, sex, and age group, and exports tables, a workbook, and metadata. **Transitional:** it still writes directly to the annual site-download pathway rather than the standard staging/approval/public pathway. |
| Briefing | `briefings/cvd_case_fatality_2023/` | [`cvd_case_fatality_2023.do`](briefings/cvd_case_fatality_2023/cvd_case_fatality_2023.do) | Analyst-owned build for the 2023 CVD case-fatality briefing. Creates released datasets and figures in staging, writes release-control metadata, and calls the shared briefing publisher. |
| Briefing | `briefings/cvd_cases_2023/` | [`cvd_cases_2023.do`](briefings/cvd_cases_2023/cvd_cases_2023.do) | Analyst-owned build for the 2023 CVD case-count briefing. Produces weekly and age-group datasets and figures in staging, then calls the shared briefing publisher. |
| Briefing | `briefings/cvd_incidence_2023/` | [`cvd_incidence_2023.do`](briefings/cvd_incidence_2023/cvd_incidence_2023.do) | Analyst-owned build for the 2023 CVD incidence briefing. Produces annual incidence and rate-ratio datasets and figures in staging, then calls the shared briefing publisher. |
| Briefing | `briefings/cvd_los_2023_v1/` | [`bnrcvd_los_2023.do`](briefings/cvd_los_2023_v1/bnrcvd_los_2023.do) | Analyst-owned build for the 2023 CVD length-of-stay briefing. Produces length-of-stay and bed-demand datasets and figures in staging, then calls the shared briefing publisher. |
| Common | `common/` | [`bnr_publish_briefing.do`](common/bnr_publish_briefing.do) | Shared packaging and publication mechanics for briefing and supporting-output packages: creates metadata and download files, an optional workbook and ZIP, copies the package to `outputs/public/`, and refreshes the site mirror. **Interim:** it currently combines actions that the planned approval-and-promotion command will separate. |
| Common | `common/` | [`bnr_publish_metric.do`](common/bnr_publish_metric.do) | Shared packaging and publication mechanics for metric packages: creates metadata and download files, ZIPs and copies the release/current datasets to `outputs/public/`, and refreshes the site mirror. **Interim:** it currently combines actions that the planned approval-and-promotion command will separate. |
| Common | `common/` | [`bnrcvd_globals.do`](common/bnrcvd_globals.do) | Defines shared run metadata, compatibility aliases, and CVD display constants. It does not define machine-specific project paths. |
| Common | `common/` | [`bnrcvd_prep_2023_v1.do`](common/bnrcvd_prep_2023_v1.do) | Central preparation step for the 2023 reporting cycle. Converts the frozen cumulative 2009–2023 CVD dataset into the full and simplified analysis-ready datasets used by downstream briefings, metrics, and tabulations. |
| Common | `common/` | [`mirror_public_to_site.do`](common/mirror_public_to_site.do) | Copies an already approved public briefing or supporting-output package into `site/downloads/files/briefings/`. It performs no analysis and does not promote staging content. |
| Configuration | `config/` | [`bnr_paths_TEMPLATE.do`](config/bnr_paths_TEMPLATE.do) | Version-controlled workstation template. Users copy it to the untracked `bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` and set the repository and private-data root paths. |
| Metric | `metrics/cvd/` | [`metric_cvd_burden.do`](metrics/cvd/metric_cvd_burden.do) | Builds reusable long-format CVD burden metric datasets, currently covering hospital-registered event counts and event distributions; writes release-stamped and `current` files to staging and calls the metric publisher. |
| Refit diagnostic | `refit/` | [`bnrcvd-2023-forensics1.do`](refit/bnrcvd-2023-forensics1.do) | Compares candidate historical stroke datasets to help identify the appropriate cumulative source, reporting record and variable counts and selected missingness checks. **Legacy-dependent:** it contains hard-coded historical workstation paths and is not part of the routine output pipeline. |
| Refit evidence | `refit/` | [`bnrcvd_2023_forensics2.do`](refit/bnrcvd_2023_forensics2.do) | Builds the supporting process-audit figure showing duplication in the historical CVD dataset file structure, stages the artefact and release-control metadata, and calls the shared briefing publisher. |

## Excluded from this inventory

- filenames containing `copy`;
- files under `docs/holding-bay/stata-legacy/`; and
- `refit/bnrcvd-2023-forensics2_original.do`, which is superseded by `refit/bnrcvd_2023_forensics2.do`.

The `.sthlp` help files in `ado/` are documentation rather than executable Stata code and are therefore not listed as separate code entries.

These exclusions should eventually be removed from the repository or retained only in an explicitly labelled archive.
